disposition_reason: Table 4 prints mean Cd and Pb and Table 5 mean P, Mg, Ca, Na, Fe, Zn, Mn, Cu and Ni for eleven retail flour types (five samples each).

study.design: retail survey of eleven flour types for radioactivity, Cd, Pb and minerals
study.market: large retailers (Italy implied by authors and consumption data)
study.method: microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; ICP-MS (iCAP Qc, KED mode) for Cd and Pb; ICP-OES and ICP-MS for minerals; HPGe gamma spectrometry for 40K and 137Cs
study.qa: calibration from aqueous multi-element reference materials; internal standard; gamma spectrometry accredited by ACCREDIA; no food CRM or recovery reported for metals
